story.description:
Story ID: KAN-16
Epic: Event Discovery
Title: Browse and discover events happening this week
Description
As a user, I want to browse events happening this week so that I can quickly discover available events, compare options, view event details, and choose an event that matches my interests.

url = http://webook.com/en/explore?date=thisweek
Business Value
Provide users with a streamlined experience for discovering and exploring events scheduled during the current week, enabling faster event selection and improved engagement.
Acceptance Criteria
AC1 – Weekly Events Access
Given the user navigates to the "This Week" events section
When the page loads
Then events scheduled for the current week should be displayed.
AC2 – Event Discovery
Users should be able to browse all available weekly events.
Essential event information should be displayed for each event.
AC3 – Event Details
Selecting an event should navigate to its detailed information page.
Event details should load successfully.
AC4 – Search & Filtering
Users should be able to search weekly events.
Users should be able to apply available filters.
Filtered results should update accordingly.
AC5 – Sorting
Available sorting options should reorder event listings appropriately.
AC6 – Pagination / Infinite Scroll
Users should be able to access additional events when more results are available.
AC7 – Empty Results
If no events match the selected criteria, an appropriate empty-state message should be displayed.
AC8 – Error Handling
Appropriate feedback should be displayed if weekly events cannot be retrieved.
AC9 – Responsiveness
The weekly events browsing experience should function consistently across supported devices and screen sizes.
Definition of Done
Weekly events are displayed successfully.
Users can browse and open event details.
Search, filtering, and sorting work correctly.
Empty and error states are handled appropriately.
The experience is responsive across supported devices.
No critical usability or accessibility issues remain.
